{{Article header|eyebrow=EDFM // Field Procedure|deck=The actionable checklist for reaching Broo Tarquin — for what he specialises in and his full blueprint list, see his own article.}}

This guide covers only the steps to reach [[Broo Tarquin]]. For what he specialises in, his full blueprint catalogue, and his place in the wider Engineer network, see his own article here: [[Broo Tarquin]].

== Objective ==
Gain access to [[Broo Tarquin]]'s services at Broo's Legacy in the Muang system.

== Prerequisites ==
{{Prerequisites|
* [[Hera Tani]] already unlocked, with enough reputation built up with her to trigger the referral (roughly grade 3–4 standing).
* Combat rank '''Competent''' or higher.
}}

== Required Materials, Equipment, and Access ==
A ship with enough cargo capacity to carry 50 units of Fujin Tea, purchased from Futen Spaceport in the Fujin system — it's typically sold only 5 tons at a time, so plan on several supply runs rather than one trip.

== Estimated Time ==
Not yet confirmed — depends heavily on how far Fujin is from your current location and how much Fujin Tea is in stock per visit. Not stated in the sources checked for [[Broo Tarquin]].

== Step-by-Step Procedure ==
{{Procedure steps|
# Unlock and build reputation with [[Hera Tani]] until Broo Tarquin appears as a referral.
# Reach Combat rank Competent or higher, if not already there.
# Travel to Futen Spaceport in the Fujin system and buy Fujin Tea, a few tons at a time, until you have 50 units.
# Travel to Broo's Legacy in the Muang system.
# Deliver the 50 units of Fujin Tea at his terminal.
}}

== Expected Result ==
{{Expected result|[[Broo Tarquin]] is unlocked and available for Engineering services at Broo's Legacy.}}

== Common Mistakes ==
{{Common mistakes|Many players think you can buy all 50 units of Fujin Tea at once, but it's limited to 5 tons per purchase. You have to do multiple trips.
}}

== Troubleshooting ==
{{Troubleshooting|
; Broo Tarquin doesn't appear as a referral even with Hera Tani unlocked
: Reputation with Hera Tani may not yet be high enough — keep engineering through her until the referral triggers.
; Engineering options don't appear at Broo's Legacy after delivering the commodity
: Try relogging — this is commonly reported to be needed before newly unlocked Engineer services become available.
}}
